cast.name: 爱德·维斯特维克 Ed Westwick

introduction: The film follows Sebastian Poe, a washed-up piano player performing across seedy jazz bars who ends up making a murderous deal with corrupt local police officer Terry Rushto repay a drug debt. Over the course of one night, Sebastian is plunged into the dark streets of Dallas’ Deep Ellum district where he comes across an odd assortment of characters. Westwick plays Stanley Roberson, a ruthless and shady figure whom Sebastian is tasked with assassinating. The film also stars Lori Petty (“You’re All Gonna Die”) as Sebastian’s sister Elise Poe.
